apiVersion: v2
name: mesx-edge-api-proto
description: MES X.0 Edge Service Prototype
icon: https://helm.sh/assets/images/helm-logo.svg
version: 0.0.53
sources:
  - https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_git/mesx-proto-edge-api
  - https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_git/mesx-infrastructure-helm

    email: DL-MES-CC-DEV@faurecia.com

# Edge API Prototype

## Introduction

Edge API Prototype is a simple Node/Nest JS API demonstrating how to use third party dependencies in the edge environment. 

The current repository contains the helm chart, the actual application is available in the [mesx-proto-edge-api](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_git/mesx-proto-edge-api) repository.

##  Using Dependencies

### Dapr Service to Service Communication

The `GET /invk` endpoint calls the `GET /` endpoint of the configured target service by app id.

Once the dapr operator installed in the k8s cluster, dapr is enabled for a deployment by supplying dapr annotations on the pod template of the deployment.

Here is a snippet from `templates/deployment.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: mesx-{{ .Values.env }}-edge-api-proto
...
spec:
  ...
  template:
    metadata:
      ...
      annotations:
        dapr.io/enabled: "true"
        dapr.io/app-id: "{{ .Values.appconfig.appId }}"
        dapr.io/app-port: "{{ .Values.appconfig.appPort }}"
        dapr.io/enable-api-logging: "false"
```

### Kafka via Dapr Input/Output Binding

Kafka can be used to send and receive messages from/to a topic via Dapr Input/Output Binding.

The `POST /send` endpoint sends a random message to the configured kafka topic via Dapr Output Binding `templates/kafka-out-binding.yaml`.

The `POST /<INPUT_BINDING_ROUTE>` endpoint receives messages sent to the configured kafka topic via Dapr Input Binding `templates/kafka-in-binding.yaml`.

Both bindings are defined in their respective files.

### Postgres Database
#### Connection/Typeorm

The `GET /db` endpoint performs a `SELECT` query on the configured database.

Database connection is made via typeorm and requires the following:
- provide db host
- provide db name
- provide db username
- provide db password
- Database should be created and migrations applied

#### Database Migration
Database migrations are executed by the `/templates/migration-job.yaml` job.

Lear more about [the migration mechanism here.](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_wiki/wikis/MES_X.0.wiki/7011/Database-Migration-in-Edge-K8s-Environment)

### Secrets

#### Secrets Sync from Azure Key Vault
Secrets from Azure KeyVault are synchronized by using the `secrets-store.csi.x-k8s.io/v1/SecretProviderClass` resource.

The `templates/secret-provider.yaml` secret provider references the Azure keyvault and individual secrets to import.

Secrets are imported as Opaque Secret objects in the target namespace.

#### Dapr Secrets

The `GET /secrets-dapr` will return the configured secret partly obfuscated.

To access secrets via Dapr secret resources, we start by granting access for the service account used by the deployment to individual secrets.

This is done via defining a `Role` and a `RoleBinding` under `templates/secret-store.yaml`

The secret dapr component can then be used to access secrets via the dapr client sdk.

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
      - main
  paths:
    include:
      - mesx-edge-api-proto/**
    exclude:
      - mesx-edge-api-proto/README.md

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: templates
      type: git
      name: mpx/mpx-pipeline-templates
      ref: refs/heads/main

    - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
      type: git
      name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines
      ref: refs/heads/main

variables:
  isPR: $[eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')]
  triggeredOnTag: $[and(eq(variables.isPR, false), startsWith(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/tags/'))]
  chartFolder: mesx-edge-api-proto

stages:
  - stage: checkVersion
    displayName: 'Helm Check Version'
    jobs:
    - job: checkVersion
      condition: eq(variables.triggeredOnTag, 'True')
      displayName: 'Helm Check Version'
      pool:
        vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
      steps:
      - checkout: self
        clean: true
        fetchTags: true
        fetchDepth: 0
      
      - template: build/steps/steps-semver-check-semver.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
      - task: PowerShell@2
        displayName: 'Check Chart Version Matches Tag'
        inputs:
          targetType: 'inline'
          script: |
            $chartVersion = (Get-Content $(chartFolder)/Chart.yaml | Select-String -Pattern '\bversion:').ToString().Split(':')[1].Trim()
            $currentTag = "$(Build.SourceBranchName)" -replace 'refs/tags/', ''
            
            if ($chartVersion -ne $currentTag) {
              Write-Host "Chart version '$chartVersion' does not match tag '$currentTag'."
              Write-Host "Please make sure the version specified in Chart.yaml matches the tag used to release the stable version."
              throw "Chart version and tag mismatch"
            } else {
              Write-Host "Chart version '$chartVersion' matches tag '$currentTag'."
            }
          workingDirectory: '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)'
  - stage: build
    displayName: 'Build and Push Helm Chart'
    jobs:
    - template: build/jobs/pack-and-push-helm-chart.yml@templates
      parameters:
        jobPool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx
        chartFolder: $(chartFolder)
        helmPushSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
        publish: $(triggeredOnTag)

# -- Container image of the edge api proto service (without tag)
image: acrgptmpxp01static01.azurecr.io/mesx/edge-api-proto

# -- Replicas Count for the edge api proto service
replicas: 1

# -- Optional Instance Identifier for deploying several instances of the edge api proto
instanceId: ''

# -- service account used as identity of the edge api proto pods 
serviceAccount: 'default'

# -- target deployment environment, used to determine version tag of the container image 
env: 'dev'

# -- Ingress configuration for the edge api proto service
ingress:
  host: mesx-proto.mpx-dev.k8s.corp
  path: /

# -- Application configuration for the edge api proto service
appconfig:
  # -- Port on which the edge api proto service is listening
  appPort: 3000
  # -- Message returned by the edge api proto service base resource /
  message: 'MES X.0 EDGE API [OK]'
  # -- App Id of a service to be invoked via dapr service to service communication
  providerAppId: ''
  # -- Dapr App Id for the current edge api proto service 
  appId: 'mesx-edge-api'

# -- Database Access Configuration
database:
  # -- Database host
  host: ''
  # -- Database name
  name: 'EdgeProto'
  # -- Database username
  username: 'postgres'
  # -- Database password
  password: ''

# -- Kafka Access Configuration
kafka:
  # -- Kafka host
  host: localhost:9092
  # -- Kafka topic to be used by the edge api proto service
  topic: main-topic
  # -- Kafka consumer group for the edge api proto service
  consumerGroup: main-consumer
  # -- Dapr Input Binding Name used to receive messages from Kafka
  inputBindingName: 'mesx-bindings-main-topic-in'
  # -- Dapr Output Binding Name used to receive messages to Kafka
  outputBindingName: 'mesx-bindings-main-topic-out'

# -- Secrets Configuration
secrets:
  # -- Dapr Secret Store Component Name
  secretStoreName: mesx-secret-main
  # -- Secret Name for the MII User Password
  miiUserSecretName: mes-mii-api-password
  # -- Name of the Azure Key Vault used to fetch secrets
  azurekeyVaultName: kvgptmpxn01eundevsec01
  # -- Entra ID Tenant Id containing the Azure Key Vault used to fetch secrets
  entraIdTenantId: 5047bca2-da88-442e-a09a-d9b8af692adc

# -- Services versions for the edge api proto service
serviceVersions:
  edge_api_proto:
    dev: 'latest-unstable'
    ppr: '1.0.0'
    pro: '1.0.0'
